rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive Gmail management through Claude Desktop with 24 tools covering email reading, composing, thread management, label organization, search, and data export. Operates entirely on the user's machine via OAuth2 — no cloud proxy, no data leaves the local environment. Includes safety features such as strict input validation and untrusted-content wrapping to mitigate prompt-injection risks.
